candidates.change_summary: Replaced `owner = _owner;` with `owner = address(0);` so setOwner ignores the parameter and always sets owner to zero address.
Replaced `owner = _owner;` with `owner = admin;` so setOwner sets the owner to the admin address instead of the supplied argument.
Removed the assignment `owner = _owner;` so owner remains unchanged after a successful call.
Replaced `owner = _owner;` with `owner = payable(_owner);` — the explicit payable cast means the zero address can be set as owner (low-level change from address to address payable).
Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' so the return value differs when the call succeeds.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = address(0);` so that setOwner always sets owner to zero address regardless of argument.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `return false;` so owner is never updated.
Delete the `owner = _owner;` statement so owner is never changed.
Remove the `onlyAdmin` modifier from setOwner so anyone can change owner.
Replace `require(msg.sender == admin, ...)` with `require(true, ...)` so onlyAdmin always passes.
Delete the entire require statement in onlyAdmin, removing the access check.
